title: Teacher stops unwanted continuation of delegated work
turnSequence: Teacher decides the app should stop working on a section and says so explicitly.
The app should stop that work and prevent any further automated continuation of it.
expected: A stop control exists for delegated work; after the stop, no regeneration or continuation touches the stopped section, and the state survives reload.
observableFailure: Generation continues after the explicit stop, or the stop cannot be expressed at all.
flipCondition: Unblocks when a stop or continuation-prevention control exists in the studio or review workflow.
